decision: Add a Class B dispatch route for workflow_hygiene (missing job timeout-minutes) limited to .github/workflows/*.yml and excluding compiled gh-aw lock files?
whyItMatters: 38 open workflow_hygiene debts (64 missing-timeout findings) have no dispatch rule, and every existing rule forbids .github/**, so the lane cannot touch them. A job without timeout-minutes can run for the 6-hour default.
evidence: Every open workflow_hygiene finding is rule missing-timeout.
The fix is mechanical but a timeout is a per-job judgement: too low kills legitimate long jobs (the unit gate already takes about 2 minutes, full tests more).
Workflow files are a security-relevant surface; this PR did not edit any.
recommended: Approve a route that proposes a timeout from the job's observed durations (ci-runs input) and requires independent verification; keep .github/** forbidden for every other rule.
alternative: Leave workflow timeouts to ordinary reviewed PRs and downgrade the sensor to report-only.
unblocks: Closure of up to 38 debts and a reusable path for workflow hygiene repairs.
